# Mowology — Professional Landscaping, Metro Vancouver

Mowology provides commercial and residential landscaping maintenance
(lawn mowing, hedge trimming, strata grounds care) in Vancouver, Burnaby,
and Richmond, BC. Est. 2019.

## What We Do
- Weekly lawn mowing and grounds maintenance
- Hedge trimming and shaping
- Strata and property management landscaping
- Seasonal cleanups (spring and fall)
- Commercial landscape maintenance

## Why Mowology
- Photo-verified service reports after every visit
- Fully insured crews ($5M liability)
- 250+ properties maintained
- 8+ years experience
- Serving property managers, strata councils, and homeowners
